messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 3960012345 - abnormal 5xx surge for model_family=calypso13b in us-west-2. 5m 5xx rate=18% (baseline ~0.6%). GPU queue depth increasing, token latencies climbing. Paging on-call.

jordan: ack, I'm on it. dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/calypso13b 

jordan: quick snapshot - total requests ~8k rpm, avg token latency ~420ms, p99 >2s. seeing OOM/retry cluster on a subset of pods. customer-visible 429s started ~3960012000.

sam: propose emergency throttle - drop per-model TPM/RPM to reduce pressure while we triage. suggest ~60% cut. objections?

maya: heads up - several small customers use calypso13b for embeddings. need impact estimate for comms.

jordan: enterprise tier unaffected due to separate routing. small/anonymous tenants will see more 429s. can whitelist enterprise API keys.

jordan: applying temp quota change now:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/v1/quota/patch" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{\n  "selector": {"model_family": "calypso13b"},\n  "changes": {"tpm": 40, "rpm": 240, "reason": "emergency load mitigation - 5xx spike", "expires_at": 3960014745}\n}'
```

devops-bot: quota patch accepted - change_id=q-patch-3960012345-1 applied to 26 nodes. new caps effective immediately.

jordan: verifying metrics after patch.

sam: while quota rolls, enable fallback to quantized-calypso13b-v2 for best-effort tenants to reduce GPU memory footprint. luis, can you shift routing weight?

luis: applying routing change now:

```yaml
- match: {model_family: calypso13b, tenant_tier: standard}
  route: calypso13b-quant-v2
  weight: 0.7
- match: {model_family: calypso13b, tenant_tier: enterprise}
  route: calypso13b-native
  weight: 1.0
```

devops-bot: routing update deployed (change_id=r-route-3960012345-2). ~35% traffic shifted to quantized variant.

alex: opening proactive tickets for top impacted customers; drafting a short blurb: "We're mitigating higher-than-normal error rates on calypso13b and may temporarily limit request throughput. Enterprise customers should be unaffected."

maya: include expected mitigation window (30m) and offer enterprise whitelist.

jordan: monitoring shows 5xx down to ~3.2% after quotas + routing, tail latency improving. keep guardrails for now.

sam: set a 15m reevaluation to consider relaxing caps. increase request-level logging for retries.

devops-bot: increased logging level for calypso13b pods (change_id=logs-3960012345-3).

jordan: handing off in 20m to emily (oncall2). adding runbook note: https://incidents.redwood/in/3960012345

emily: taking handoff at 3960013600. paste exact expire timestamp for quota change?

jordan: expires_at was set to 3960014745 (~20m out). will extend if we see stability.

luis: also observed a noisy customer script tied to API key k-xyz123 that was amplifying the tail. applied key-level rate-limit which reduced a big chunk of load.

alex: notified owner of k-xyz123 and suggested mitigation steps.

emily: dashboards look better - 5xx ~1.1% and p99 latency trending down. I'll watch for 30m then coordinate rollback.

jordan: mitigation checklist for post-incident: quota patch, routing fallback to quantized variant, API-key rate-limit, increased logs. will draft postmortem if stable.

devops-bot: audit entries: q-patch-3960012345-1, r-route-3960012345-2, logs-3960012345-3, api-key-rate-limit-k-xyz123.

emily: status update 3960014988 - healthy for 10m. planning to lift temporary cap in 10m if no regression. leaving oncall watch. :white_check_mark: 

maya: thanks team. cust-success please send the 30m notice to impacted customers with rollback ETA.

alex: sending now, including incident link and ETA.

jordan: closing active mitigation actions; incident remains open for postmortem and follow-up.
